title: Proper qcqs integral-to-rational scalar comparison with the counit normalization
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $F\subseteq E$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed algebraic closure, $A=\mathcal O_F$, and $\Lambda=E$, with their induced norm topologies as in [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Let $h:U\to V$ be a proper morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use $A_W=p_W^*\underline A$, $\Lambda_W=p_W^*\underline\Lambda$, the ordinary unbounded derived module-object categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and $T_W=\Lambda_W\otimes^L_{A_W}-$ in the universe [def-weil-size-convention]. For every $J\in\mathrm D_{\mathrm{ctf}}(U,A)$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the canonical coefficient-change map
$$\rho_{h,J}:T_V Rh_{*,A}J\longrightarrow Rh_{*,\Lambda}T_UJ$$
is an isomorphism. Its definition is the transpose under $h_\Lambda^*\dashv Rh_{*,\Lambda}$ of
$$h_\Lambda^*T_V Rh_{*,A}J\xrightarrow{\sim}T_U h_A^*Rh_{*,A}J\xrightarrow{T_U(\varepsilon_{h,A,J})}T_UJ,$$
where the first arrow is the inverse of the scalar/pullback mate of [lem-sfb-kflat-scalar-comparison-normalization], transported by the canonical section-module equivalences [lem-sfb-internal-module-operations-transport]. Thus this is the coefficient projection map with its specified counit. No geometric base-change assertion and no Noetherian, characteristic, dimension or invertibility-of-$\ell$ hypothesis is included. The coefficient field here is finite over $\mathbf Q_\ell$; the analogous assertion for all continuous functions into the norm-topological algebraic closure is false in this general qcqs scope (see the statement dispute in the split report).

source.place: (2), scalar extension in the proper closed-complement calculation. Agent proper coefficient projection lemma for this qcqs finite-model scope. The full all-continuous norm-topological clause is not attributed to a finite-subextension-valued coefficient comparison or to the colimit-topological algebraic closure.

proof.text: Retain the published internal-module categories, scalar extension, pullback comparison and counit transpose. Factor the coefficient map O_F → E as O_F → F → E. Flatness of the localization follows from [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-invert-ell], and flatness of the finite extension follows from [det-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients-finite-free]; the ordinary extension-composition isomorphism gives flatness of their composite. Properness implies quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness by the standard scheme instances. The boundedness clause in [sk-def-sfb-constructible] gives boundedness below of J.

Apply [lem-sfb-localized-direct-image-comparison] to O_F → F and J. Its map is the existing derivedPushHom component and is invertible for this bounded-below input. Apply the already proved source-library instance [lem-sfb-subfield-push-iso] to F → E and the unbounded scalar extension of J. This makes the second derivedPushHom component invertible without a separate section-module or basis calculation.

For any tower of flat condensed coefficient maps, the restriction-of-scalars composition isomorphism is comapComp followed by comapCongr for coefficientMap_comp. Every underlying component is the identity, so the ordinary restriction/direct-image squares respect it. Lift that identity to derived categories: test natural transformations on K-injective representatives using [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property], expand the defining right-derived units and the factorization isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], and use the composition-unit identity for [lem-fin-kinjective-derived-composition]. Naturality reduces both sides to the same termwise identity. This proves coherence for precisely the published derivedComapLowerStarIso, rather than choosing a new comparison.

Conjugate the derived restriction compositors to scalar-extension compositors. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting], including its change-of-adjunction clauses, to the coherent squares of step 3. The composite derivedPushHom component, after an isomorphism on its source, is the product of scalar extension of the first comparison, the second comparison, and direct image of a scalar-composition isomorphism. All factors are invertible by step 2. The comparison definition is expressed by this canonical derivedPushHom component to share the derived-adjunction data without repeatedly unfolding tensor resolutions. The proved generic push_counit_formula preserves its specified counit normalization: iterated mate cancellation identifies derivedPushHom with the mate of derivedPullIso.inv, and [lem-amb-mate-unit-counit] identifies its adjoint transpose with the inverse pullback comparison followed by scalar extension of the specified geometric counit. Thus this is exactly the original counit-transpose definition of properIntegralRationalScalarComparison, with all coefficient maps, scalar adjunctions and geometric adjunctions fixed as before.
